summary.text: Jessie Lopez is a Democratic member of the Santa Ana City Council running for California State Assembly District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces fellow Democrat David Penaloza.
She has represented Ward 3 since December 2020.

paragraphs.text: Jessie Lopez was born in Santa Ana, California, and earned a high school diploma from Santa Ana High School, an associate degree from Santa Ana College and a bachelor's degree from California State University, Long Beach.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the daughter of working-class immigrants who worked two jobs to put herself through college.
Lopez assumed office on the Santa Ana City Council on December 8, 2020, and her current term ends in 2028.
She said in the survey that she led efforts to cap excessive rent increases and protect seniors from eviction and passed a lobbyist transparency law.
Her stated priorities for the Assembly include Medicare for All, affordable housing, stopping corporations from buying single-family homes, action on wage theft and full funding for public education.
